queryCommand: GET is read-only; optional repository filter and anomaly-first pageToken pagination
authorization: Bearer operator token is verified with constant-time comparison
freshness: observedAt/lastHealthyAt/stale are projected per component together with the latest failed job and up to 20 recent failed/ignored delivery identities; DB failure is HTTP 503
idempotency: GET has no side effects and no durable mutation
failure: unknown/stale/disconnected state is never projected as healthy; 503 includes only lastSuccessfulAt and bounded-retry metadata
retryCancel: Retry-After bounds transient retries; clients may issue a newer query and discard the older pageToken lineage
audit: query failures are emitted to structured operational logs; reads do not create per-user audit rows

queryCommand: command accepts deliveryId and observedAttempts and returns attemptId/state
authorization: Bearer operator token is required; actor is persisted
freshness: delivery status, route attempts, Registration enabled flag and version are locked and revalidated
idempotency: Idempotency-Key returns the same attempt; conflicting payload reuse is HTTP 409
failure: processing/processed, disabled, missing, and stale Registration are rejected with reason/current state/routeAttempts and without a new execution attempt; the rejection itself receives a durable attemptId
retryCancel: transport retry uses the same key; accepted attempt returns cancellable=false rather than implying cancellation
audit: accepted and rejected outcomes persist actor, delivery, attemptId, observed attempts, reason and time transactionally; rejected Idempotency-Key replay returns the same attemptId
